sentences: Blepharitis is a chronic inflammatory process of the eyelid margins
It can affect individuals of any age and is characterized by symptoms such as burning sensation, irritation, tearing, photophobia, blurred vision, and red eyes
Blepharitis may be classified into two subtypes based on the anatomic location: anterior and posterior; it can also be categorized based on symptom duration as either acute or chronic

The exact pathogenesis of blepharitis is not fully understood; however, it is thought to be caused by bacterial colonization (e.g., Staphylococcus aureus, Staphylococcus epidermidis) or meibomian gland dysfunction
Other contributing factors include allergens and parasitic infestations, such as Demodex mites
Common systemic associations include rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis
Diagnosis of blepharitis is primarily based on clinical features as there are no specific diagnostic laboratory tests
Treatment involves long-term eyelid hygiene and may include topical or systemic antibiotics depending on the underlying cause and severity of the condition
Although it is not sight-threatening, blepharitis can lead to permanent alterations of the eyelid margin if left untreated
